name: orchestration
description: Governor/Liaison split for multi-lane agent phases: `govern` opens the policy-and-sequencing authority (read-only inspection, docs-only writes, receipt audits); `liaison` runs one lane's mechanics (worktrees, build dispatch, gates, commits, PRs) and can never merge to main.
